title: NetSuite AR Automation: How to Automate Accounts Receivable in NetSuite
summary: What NetSuite AR automation is, what NetSuite handles natively, where it stops, and how AI agents automate accounts receivable in NetSuite: collections, cash application, and more.
body_markdown:
NetSuite invoices customers and tracks what they owe, but getting paid is a different job. Following up on overdue accounts, applying the cash that comes back to the right invoices, and resolving the exceptions is still largely manual, which is why DSO creeps up even on a modern ERP. **NetSuite AR automation** closes that gap, using software to run the full accounts receivable workflow inside NetSuite so cash comes in faster with less manual chasing.


This guide explains what NetSuite AR automation is, what NetSuite handles natively, where it stops, and how to automate accounts receivable in NetSuite, including with AI agents.


## **What is NetSuite AR automation?**


NetSuite AR automation is the use of software to run accounts receivable inside NetSuite, generating invoices, applying incoming payments, chasing overdue accounts, and reporting on AR aging, with less manual work. NetSuite handles invoicing and the AR ledger; AI agents and SuiteApps extend it to the collections follow-up, cash application, and exception work it does not fully automate on its own.


> NetSuite invoices the customer and tracks what is owed. The automation gap is getting paid, following up on overdue accounts and matching the cash that comes back, which is where agents and add-ons earn their place.


## **What NetSuite handles natively, and where it stops**


NetSuite covers the issuing side of AR well:


- **Invoicing and the AR ledger.** NetSuite generates invoices and tracks receivables and the[AR aging](https://www.concourse.ai/insights/accounts-receivable-aging-report) .
- **Customer payments.** NetSuite records payments and applies them to invoices.
- **Statements and reminders.** NetSuite can send customer statements and basic reminders.
- **Revenue recognition.** NetSuite's module handles rev rec where it applies.


Where NetSuite stops is the work that actually brings cash in: automated, escalating collections cadences, prioritizing which accounts to chase, matching high volumes of incoming payments and remittance to the right invoices, and resolving short-pays and disputes. Teams fill that gap with SuiteApps or AI agents.


## **The AR workflow to automate in NetSuite**


Accounts receivable is a chain, and each link can be automated to a different degree:


- **Invoice.** Generate and deliver the invoice to the customer.
- **Follow up.** Send reminders and escalations on a cadence, prioritizing at-risk accounts.
- **Collect.** Work disputes and promises to pay.
- **Apply cash.** Match incoming payments and remittance to the right open invoices.
- **Reconcile.** Confirm the cash ties to the bank and the ledger.
- **Report.** Keep AR aging and DSO current.


## **How to automate accounts receivable in NetSuite**


There are three layers, and most teams combine them:


- **Native NetSuite features.** Invoicing, payment application, and statements cover the issuing side out of the box.
- **AR SuiteApps and add-ons.** Collections and cash-application tools from the SuiteApp marketplace add dunning cadences and payment matching. ## **Benefits of automating AR in NetSuite**


- **Lower DSO.** Consistent, prioritized follow-up brings cash in sooner.
- **Less manual chasing.** Reminders and escalations run on a cadence instead of by hand.
- **Faster cash application.** Incoming payments match to invoices automatically, even with messy remittance.
- **Scales without headcount.** More customers and invoices without more collectors.
- **Audit-ready.** Every follow-up, payment, and match traces back to source inside NetSuite.


## **Frequently asked questions**


### **What is NetSuite AR automation?**


NetSuite AR automation is the use of software to run accounts receivable inside NetSuite, generating invoices, applying incoming payments, chasing overdue accounts, and reporting on AR aging, with less manual work. NetSuite provides invoicing and the ledger; SuiteApps and AI agents automate collections follow-up, cash application, and exceptions.


### **Does NetSuite have built-in AR automation?**


Partly. NetSuite natively generates invoices, records and applies customer payments, sends statements, and tracks AR aging. It does not fully automate escalating collections cadences, high-volume cash application, or dispute handling, which is why teams add AR SuiteApps or AI agents on top.


### **How do you automate accounts receivable in NetSuite?**


Use NetSuite's native invoicing and payment features, then add collections and cash-application SuiteApps or AI agents that connect to NetSuite and run follow-up, payment matching, and exception handling end to end, with a human approving.


### **What is the difference between NetSuite AR and AP automation?**


[NetSuite AP automation](https://www.concourse.ai/insights/netsuite-ap-automation) handles money going out: capturing, coding, matching, and paying vendor bills. NetSuite AR automation handles money coming in: invoicing, collections follow-up, and applying customer payments. Both close the manual gaps NetSuite leaves around its core records, and an AI agent can run both.


## **The bottom line**


NetSuite gives accounts receivable a solid issuing engine, invoicing, payment application, statements, and aging, but leaves the collections follow-up, cash application, and exception work manual. NetSuite AR automation closes that gap, and the strongest option is an AI agent that connects natively to NetSuite and runs the whole workflow, from invoice to cash, with a human approving.
